contact_invite.page_description: Issue and manage invite URLs for adding contacts. Anyone you share the URL with can add you as a contact.

list.empty: No invite URLs have been issued yet

contact_invite_guide.title: How to Use Invite URL Management
contact_invite_guide.description: With invite URLs, others can add you as a contact just by receiving a URL or scanning a QR code. Great for SNS profiles or as a digital business card.

what.title: What is an invite URL?
what.body: A dedicated link that lets others add you as a contact. When you share the URL, the recipient can add you with a single tap — no need to share your ID or email address directly.

create.title: Issue a URL
create.body: Tap "Issue New URL" in the top right to create a URL tailored to your needs.
create.step1: Tap "Issue New URL" in the top right.
create.step2: Choose a label (optional note), the number of uses allowed, and an expiration period. Setting limits helps prevent misuse.
create.step3: Tap "Issue" and the new invite URL and QR code will appear in the list.

share.title: Share with others
share.body: You can share the issued URL by copying it and sending it, or by having someone scan the QR code.
share.step1: Tap the "Copy" button next to the URL.
share.step2: Paste it into a LINE message, email, or your SNS profile to share.
share.step3: In person, just show the QR code and have the other person scan it with their camera.

manage.title: Track usage and revoke
manage.body: All issued URLs are listed so you can manage them at a glance. Each entry shows the number of times used, the usage limit, and the expiration date.
manage.note: You can revoke any URL at any time by tapping the trash icon. Once revoked, no one can use that URL to add you as a contact.
